comment: The maker never called configInput for this jack, so Rack's hover tooltip for it is blank and the census records it with no name. It is a real PortWidget added with addInput and it accepts a cable; the InvisiblePort constructor loads PJ301M.svg and then hides the drawn parts, leaving a jack that works and cannot be seen. A full turn at 10V follows from 0.2 times pi radians per volt; the three-revolutions figure is the 20.0 radians-per-second slew limit divided by two pi, and neither derived number is stated by the maker. The ampersand between PATCH and TWEAK is not part of the panel artwork: it is a separate rotating widget, which is why the panel SVG renders with a gap where it belongs.
